song.derivation: supported onset=canonical score+traversal; alternate_restrike split at source note_on; each split inherits aggregate direction; end=min(sustain,release); no source-origin shift; +policy pre-roll; horizon=ceil((audio+pre-roll+tail)*60)/60
song.direction_scope: aggregate plan direction inherited independently by each split note; second direction is not inferred

contact_measurement.finger_proxies: 128 actual-triangle distal flexion-side patch samples per assigned finger
contact_measurement.surface_sampling: clipped eligible source triangles, deterministic stratified area sampling
contact_measurement.candidate: any same assigned distal patch point within inward finite fret cell, lateral3mm and signed plane height[-1,3]mm, facing cosine>=0.1, with distal body load
contact_measurement.evidence: GPU net rigid body contact force and live source-mesh surface geometry
contact_measurement.limitations: no body pair, contact witness, calibrated string force, pressure, vibration or sound; finite sampling can miss surface contacts
contact_measurement.compatibility: new measurement; original pair-feature clean success is not inherited

wrong_press.effective: selected target geometry: own loaded facing distal pad at a higher fret on the target string or an unauthorized string/fret, or another finger at a higher fret on the target string; penalties only on audible overlap
wrong_press.own: same-string higher distal pad blocks even with positive assigned pad or simultaneous authorization; otherwise positive assigned pad takes precedence over incidental own samples and simultaneous active selected own target cells are authorized
wrong_press.other: full thumb/finger2/3 loaded virtual-string samples; same/lower fret is not wrong; higher blocks even with positive assigned pad
wrong_press.pad_geometry: finite unique nearest press-plane string within3mm, signed height[-1,3]mm, facing cosine>=0.1, distal netload>=0.01N, fret interior inset2mm
wrong_press.times: raw geometry at both physics endpoints, integrated over clipped audible overlap; no time-mask before trapezoid; overlapping sources do not multiply penalty
wrong_press.confidence: only unambiguous fret interiors contribute; no inferred wrong from unloaded/absent contact
wrong_press.source_fret_range: inclusive min/max contributing source fret per target/body; read only where source time>0
wrong_press.next_preparation: matches future scoped own finger/string/fret in press-2..onset; diagnostic only, never exempts current interference
wrong_press.scope: GPU left finger-skill only; net body force cannot identify contact partner, calibrated pressure or sound

finger_skill.source_clock: original task time = local physics seconds + score_offset_s
finger_skill.reset_selection: initial balanced phrase; future resets switch to full song after fixed committed budget
finger_skill.evaluation: explicit runtime view; original full song or balanced phrases; same policy and control contract

reward.candidate_scope: no body pair, contact witness, calibrated string force, pressure, vibration or sound; finite sampling can miss surface contacts
reward.safety_cost: no running physics cost; one unified physical/wrist failure cost

action_change.initial_previous: zero at episode reset; first tick included; collection boundaries preserve previous action
action_change.scope: GPU left only; normalized command differences, not actual joint velocity, force or target motion; LH21 including thumb free

surface_learning.approach: gamma*Phi(actual_next_state,time)-Phi(current_state,time); true terminal Phi0; no horizon reset
surface_learning.contact_sampling: 240Hz adjacent valid candidate endpoints; only overlap with press..end counts; collection boundaries do not reset streak
surface_learning.achievement: 0.25*b once at unchanged continuous clean threshold
surface_learning.penalty_window: audible wrong and incremental missing; one max(missing/D,streak deficit) settlement at note end; no repeated missed penalty or synthetic failure tail
surface_learning.penalty_balance: same target_count/(present_fingers*finger_count) as positive terms; D=end-onset>0; no preparation penalty
surface_learning.observation: 557state/24event/8priority; positive pad geometry unchanged, wrong rules v2; observable wrist termination4

press_surface.extraction: two physical source neck mesh convex hulls; common most-upward facet plane; complete inward segments in a source hull
press_surface.projection: Gz only; preserve string x/y; existing surface geometry with negative inward margin
press_surface.scope: Approach observation/reward target only; no contact/success or physics changes. Source convex hull proof, not exact PhysX cooked geometry or pressure certification.

pad.coordinate_frame: distal body local after source mesh scale/geom transform
pad.sampling: actual eligible triangle clipping then equal-area CDF strata and deterministic barycentric interiors
pad.normals: unit outward triangle cross-product after mesh scale/geom transform

frame_source.rest_rotation: identity for palm-relative finger1 and consecutive finger2/3/top
frame_source.attachment: palm-to-finger1 position may vary; segment direction is defined by child2/3/top offsets
frame_source.limitation: actual source-body geometric flexion; not native spherical coordinates or anatomical range certification

pad.limitation: model flexion-side engineering patch; not anatomical annotation, native contact location or pressure certification; finite samples may miss contacts

finger_posture.reference: user-selected static B; flexion preference only, never a joint target or required waypoint
finger_posture.gate: score-only per-finger active union; release grace0.05s then0.1s fade; next press preparation0.35s with0.1s fade; short gaps direct, medium gaps partial recovery
finger_posture.tracking: quality multiplied by1-idle_weight; wrist and arm lookahead remains2s
finger_posture.contact_veto: none outside protected press..end; residual candidate/wrong cannot block recovery
finger_posture.proximity_veto: distance never suppresses recovery; nonfinite own relevant distances still invalidate that finger
finger_posture.rate: standby_rate_per_s * mean4(per_finger_gate * quality); fixed four-finger denominator
finger_posture.integration: actual240Hz dt, existing approach stage weight
finger_posture.scope: optional independent finger idle bonus only; no thumb/spread target, movement cost, penalty, control/reset change or success prerequisite

frame_source.rest_rotation: identity for palm-relative finger1 and consecutive finger2/3/top
frame_source.attachment: palm-to-finger1 position may vary; segment direction is defined by child2/3/top offsets
frame_source.limitation: actual source-body geometric flexion; not native spherical coordinates or anatomical range certification

thumb_support.patch: thumb-specific source -x distal/+z flexion/-y inward-side triangles; same sampled point and outward normal
thumb_support.region: face-referenced physical playing-neck1 rear, central 50% width, work-fret center Gy +/-0.04m clipped to neck1; unused OBJ vertices and headstock transition excluded
thumb_support.gap: signed outward rear-plane distance; maximum quality at0..0.003m
thumb_support.penetration: smoothstep from0 at-0.001m to1 at0; zero below-0.001m
thumb_support.contact_candidate: same sample signed gap[-0.001,0.0005]m, region excess<=1e-6m, facing>=0.1 and thumb3 rear-normal net load>=0.01N
thumb_support.reward: 0.01/s geometric quality +0.01/s same-point geometric quality times binary contact candidate; larger loads give no extra reward
thumb_support.net_load: relu(thumb3 native resultant force in guitar coordinates dot unit source rear normal); absent/nonfinite input disables contact candidate
thumb_support.selection: maximum rate, then maximum geometric quality, then nearest finite-region point; first sample only at exact distance tie
thumb_support.integration: rate only; caller integrates completed physics dt and failure suppression
thumb_support.limitation: finite source samples, not cooked collision geometry, anatomical annotation, contact-pair or pressure certification

patch_diagnostics.sampling_frame: proper rotation: canonical(x,y,z)=body(z,x,y); inverse maps samples/normals to thumb body

thumb_support.failed_tick: entire failed60Hz tick receives zero positive reward

finger_skill.weights: no group weighting; final effective coefficients recorded in simplified
finger_skill.purpose: joint selected original task; nine fixed terms; no phase/music-stage gates
finger_skill.balance: selected M/(selected present fingers*selected own-finger count)
finger_skill.wrong: assigned-pad error or other-finger higher fret; selected targets, audible overlap penalties
finger_skill.preparation_boundary: selected notes plus first following original note per finger; no artificial tail rest bonus

simplified.balance: selected M/(present selected fingers*selected own-finger count), applied once
simplified.performance: incremental missing payments then one max(missing/D,1-best_streak/required) settlement
simplified.positive_failure_tick: suppressed; negative terminal potential and observed note deficits retained

failure_cost.remaining_note_budget: selected unsettled unobserved wrong .15b plus unpaid performance .10b
failure_cost.application: once at failed60Hz boundary; physical and wrist failure share one payment

termination.finger_skill_terminal: natural finite view end is terminal; H32 collection boundary is not an episode end

wrist.target_transition_grace: none; timers survive source target changes
wrist.normal_timer: accumulate above3cm; active2..3cm recovery subtracts dt; at/below2cm resets
wrist.normal_timer_scope: net outside time, not continuous hysteresis-latch time

differences: GPU PhysX solver and native contact backend
Explicit geometry lower mass; native CUDA mass comparison is recorded separately
Fixed-step damped foot IK replaces CPU SciPy least_squares
Triangle source proximity replaces CPU convex optimizer
Initial/reset upper Jacobian uses source child-axis geometry until GPU refresh

action_codec.reference: scene prepared reference105_rad; not B standby pose or actual q
action_codec.target_request: reference + action * (native_upper - reference) if action >= 0; reference + action * (reference - native_lower) otherwise
action_codec.zero_action: return to prepared reference target, rate limited
action_codec.full_scale_actions: -1 requests native lower; +1 requests native upper
action_codec.limit_memory: clamped target only; no integrated action; no automatic B return
action_codec.remaining_actions: unchanged reset-reference affine offsets, smoothing and rate limits

wrist_region.reference: physical midpoint of allowed_fret_range outer cell boundaries; lower source neck edge at anchor-cell midpoint; source playing plane
wrist_region.interpolation: linear lower/upper bounds; clamp before/after track; input time excludes policy pre-roll
wrist_region.position: zero inside inclusive bounds; outside -q/(1+q), q=sum((excess/scales)^2)

finger_tracking.selection: one per present finger: audible earliest end, else press-2..end earliest onset; original-order ties
finger_tracking.window: onset<=now<end for audible; press-2<=now<end for preparation
finger_tracking.error: target minus nearest designated distal flexion-side mesh patch sample
finger_tracking.rate: 2/s * sum(valid selected qualities) / song-present finger count
finger_tracking.integration: caller integrates actual physics dt; helper returns rate only
finger_tracking.motion_cost: none; no requested-motion or surface-velocity suppression

finger_tracking.normal_cos: nearest sample outward normal dot negative press-plane unit normal
finger_tracking.recovery: per-finger quality multiplied by shared score-only tracking_weight; zero during full B recovery

finger_shape.active: valid selected tracking target, including candidate/clean contact
finger_shape.rate: shape_rate_per_s * mean4(active * quality); fixed four-finger denominator
finger_shape.scope: optional weak preference, no thumb/spread/MCP target, coupling, action or velocity cost
finger_shape.interpretation: experimental geometric angle preference only; no calibrated string pressure or sound, no joint ratio/range/control constraint

simultaneous_press.wrong: union over targets and both endpoints, conservative full interval
